package tag

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// GetTagByID fetches tag by id.
type GetTagByID struct {
	Tags repository.TagRepository
}

// Handle returns tag by id.
func (uc GetTagByID) Handle(ctx context.Context, id int) (*domain.Tag, error) {
	tag, err := uc.Tags.GetByID(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return tag, nil
}
